Multiple red flags: severe overvaluation (PE at year high, Graham shows huge overvaluation), RSI overbought, momentum extreme. But fundamentals still strong, so might not be immediate crash. But for monthly outlook, risk of correction is high. I'd set confidence 80-85%.

Reasoning: Mention PE 46.65, PB 15.25 at upper bound, PEG 2.33, G Number 238, RSI 81.8, April revenue +4.6% only, Q4 margin compression, potential for valuation contraction if growth disappoints. Worst-case: AI hype fades, PE compresses to 20, stock could halve.
